milestones.title: Status lists are signed with the officer's step-up

remediation: An edge holding classified data accepts only a status list signed in the last 24 hours, even when nothing changed. Every list signature needs an officer's passkey step-up, so a security officer must sign again at least daily for such edges. Your organization plans that duty, with a backup officer, before a classified edge goes live.
title: Classified edges need a status list signed every day
